result.rationale: The diff adds `put "members" => "groups#add_members"` inside the admin `resources :groups` block, which yields `params[:id]` for a member route, while `add_members` calls `params.require(:group_id)`. adjudication.rationale: In `config/routes.rb`, `put "members" => "groups#add_members"` and `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` are defined inside `resources :groups` without `collection`, so they are member routes and will be invoked as `/admin/groups/:id/members(.json)` (the UI does exactly this: `'/admin/groups/' + this.get('id') + '/members.json'`). Member routes supply the group identifier as `params[:id]`, but both controller actions require `:group_id` (`Group.find(params.require(:group_id).to_i)`), which will raise `ActionController::ParameterMissing` at runtime. The specs pass because they call the controller actions directly with `group_id:` and thus don’t exercise routing/param naming.
